faq: Do I need a Shopify Plus plan?

Most of this work, such as checkout customization, needs a Plus plan, billed by Shopify directly to you. If you are on another plan, tell us in the order form and we confirm what is possible before we start.
Can you work without touching my live checkout?
Yes. We build and test on a development store first, and move changes to your live store only when you approve. Checkout changes go live at a time you choose, so shoppers are not caught mid-order.

Plus projects can grow without end, so we fix the scope up front. Each package covers a set number of extensions, companies and Functions. Bigger programs are quoted separately, and we can plan them in stages.
Can you replace my old checkout scripts?

Yes. Shopify is moving checkout scripts to Functions and extensions. We read your current scripts, rebuild the logic in the supported way and test it. We cover what fits the package and quote the rest.

desc:
Shopify Plus customization and B2B setup puts the advanced features of the Plus plan to work: a tailored checkout, wholesale pricing, expansion stores and custom Functions. Ecom Swift LLC delivers each as a scoped sprint inside your own Plus account.

## What is Shopify Plus customization?

Shopify Plus customization is the configuration and development of features that are available on the Plus plan, such as checkout branding and extensions, B2B and wholesale tools, expansion stores and Shopify Functions. These features let a store behave in ways a standard plan cannot, without moving to a custom platform.

Many Plus merchants pay for the plan and use only part of it. The features exist, but setting them up takes planning, testing and some development, and day-to-day work always seems more urgent. A scoped sprint turns the plan you already pay for into working tools.

## Why a Plus setup is worth doing properly

Checkout is where the order is won or lost, and on Plus you can shape it. Wholesale buyers expect their own prices, payment terms and ordering flow, and a store without these forces them back to email and spreadsheets. A new region usually needs its own currency, content and catalog rules. Custom discount or shipping logic often ends up as fragile workarounds if no one builds it correctly.

Changes to checkout and pricing logic also carry risk. A mistake can block an order or apply the wrong price. That is why careful scoping, a development store and a clear switch-over matter more here than on a simple theme edit.

## How Plus work affects results

The mechanisms differ by feature. A checkout extension, such as a delivery note field, a banner or a trust message, removes questions at the moment of payment. B2B tools let trade customers log in, see their price list and order without manual quotes, which saves your team time and shortens the order cycle. A Shopify Function can apply a rule, such as a tiered discount or a shipping option, directly in the platform, so it works consistently.

Results depend on your customers and your operation. We describe what each feature improves and build it to your agreed scope, without predicting a revenue figure.

## What a strong Plus setup can include

- Checkout branding: logo, colors, fonts and layout settings.
- Checkout extensions for banners, extra fields or order messages.
- Company accounts with locations and contacts for wholesale buyers.
- Price lists and catalogs for different customer groups.
- Payment terms, such as pay later, set for each company.
- Shopify Functions for discounts, shipping or payment rules.
- An expansion store configured for a new region.
- Markets and currencies set up for that store.
- Work built and tested on a development store before it touches your live shop.
- Handover notes, so your team knows how everything works.

## How a sprint works

We begin by agreeing a scope with you in writing. A sprint is short on purpose, so it needs a clear target and a list of what is included. You choose the task, for example one checkout change, or checkout plus B2B setup, or a fuller package with an expansion store.

We then build on a development store, check each piece against your rules, and prepare the move to your live store. Moving live happens with you, at a quiet time, with a rollback plan. The Basic package covers one focused task and one extension, the Standard package adds more extensions, B2B for several companies and one Function, and the Premium package adds more of each plus an expansion store, with fixes after go-live. If you use old checkout customizations, we tell you what needs to be rebuilt in the current extension model.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Write down the exact behavior you want before we begin.
- List your customer groups, price tiers and payment terms for B2B.
- Test changes on a development store first.
- Keep the scope narrow and add a second sprint if needed.
- Plan the go-live for a low-traffic period.

**Avoid:**
- Changing live checkout without a tested fallback.
- Asking for many unrelated features in one short sprint.
- Building custom logic when a built-in setting already does the job.
- Leaving old scripts and new extensions to conflict.
- Skipping a test order after each change.

## Who this is for

This service suits Plus merchants who have postponed B2B, brands launching in a new country who need an expansion store, and teams whose discount or shipping rules are handled by manual workarounds. It also suits stores still using older checkout customizations that need to be moved to current methods.

## What we need from you

A Shopify Plus plan is required for these features. Send us a short description of what you want, plus examples such as your price lists or discount rules. Give us collaborator or staff access to your Plus organization, or a developer user on a development store. We never need passwords. We reply with a written scope before work begins.
